requirements.heading: Source-Port Field Definition
requirements.text: When present in a report, it MUST contain the client port of the TCP connection from which the reported message originated, corresponding to the "Source-IP" field that contains the client address of that same connection, thereby describing completely the origin of the abuse incident.

requirements.heading: Source-Port Field Definition
requirements.text: When any report is generated that includes the "Source-IP" field (see Section 3.2 of [ARF]), this field SHOULD also be present, unless the port number is unavailable.

requirements.heading: Source-Port Field Definition
requirements.text: Use of this field is RECOMMENDED for reports generated per [AUTHFAILURE-REPORT] (see Section 3.1 of that document).

requirements.heading: Time Accuracy
requirements.text: Report generators that include an Arrival-Date report field MAY choose to express the value of that date in Universal Coordinated Time (UTC) to enable simpler correlation with local records at sites that are following the provisions of [LOG].
